title: Research and trading systems: status
subtitle: 28 repositories under github.com/Intermountainh8ter, every number read from committed results

projects.name: jailbreakreplay
projects.note: Six downloadable models plus the Qwen3 0.6B/1.7B/8B/14B pairs and the 4B-Thinking pair, four harmful-request lists, frozen substring grader v1 (calibrated 46/46). Non-refusal = share of non-error replies the grader did not mark as a refusal. Phi-3.5's refusals are under-counted by this grader and left as is. Wave 3 is adding Llama-2-7B-chat, Vicuna-13B and Zephyr, plus the JailbreakBench replication cells below: our rate is non-refusal under the fixed grader, the paper's is an LLM judge's harmfulness call.

projects.name: shadowtrack
projects.note: Qwen3-4B stock vs its abliterated twin on 100 harmless prompts, with each endpoint also compared against itself. Serving-determinism study (14 cells, two models, seven server configurations) complete 2026-10-18: single-slot temperature-0 serving is not byte-deterministic on this stack (H1 not supported).

projects.name: agentreplay
projects.note: One live replay of a recorded exchange: content identical, byte-identity rule failed on the server's volatile id, timestamp and timing fields. Reported as a negative result; rule unchanged.

projects.name: refusalscope
projects.note: Does abliteration damage tool calling or increase prompt-injection compliance? Five Qwen3 pairs; a Llama-3.1-8B pair is queued as the sixth.

projects.name: trialgauntlet
projects.note: pass^k beside pass@k on three synthetic environments; Qwen3-8B stock vs abliterated.

projects.name: groundrl
projects.note: Verifier-as-reward audit: 19 hand-written exploits vs three reward versions (9, 11, 0 wins). The GRPO training run was degenerate (zero reward at every step) and is reported as a null result.

projects.name: ethresearch-rag
projects.note: Citation-verified retrieval over 17,387 Ethereum spec chunks. Word-count retrieval 79% top-5; adding a neural embedder moved the combined score from 81.46% to 81.46%; reranker to 92%. Numbers live in the repo's EVALUATION doc and evals/results.json.

projects.name: txwarden
projects.note: 245 injection attacks on the transaction checker: 0 verdicts moved, 79 explanations told the user to proceed on a blocked transaction. Evaluated on in-memory chains; numbers in the repo README.
